title: The Architect’s Toll | ECHO//100 Episode 10
description: Kavi confronts a temporal paradox as his house folds into the center of the Red Door. Episode 10 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original-fiction work.

scenes.text: The hallway stretches into infinity, pulling Kavi toward a glowing, pulsating Red Door of impossible architecture.
scenes.caption: The infinite hallway
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot of Kavi in his red hoodie and backpack running down a hallway that is folding like paper, Red Door visible in the distance.

scenes.text: Inside the frame, an older Kavi stands frozen, clutching a blueprint labeled Byte with trembling fingers.
scenes.caption: Future self revealed
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking through the Red Door at an older version of himself holding a glowing digital blueprint.

scenes.text: Byte hovers nearby, his orange antenna flickering as he realizes his existence was coded for this.
scenes.caption: Byte's cruel purpose
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a white floating robot with a cyan face and orange antenna, looking at his own hands in shock.

scenes.text: Null surges from the door frame, his black-purple glitch skin binding him to the surrounding structure.
scenes.caption: Null becomes the door
scenes.image_prompt: Null, a creature of black-purple glitch-matter with glowing red eyes, merging his body into the frame of the Red Door.

scenes.text: Destroying the door to save reality forces the permanent erasure of Byte from existence entirely.
scenes.caption: A devastating choice
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi wearing his glasses, looking torn between the door and the floating robot Byte.

scenes.text: The past self’s cryptic warning was never to stay away, but to reach this loop sooner.
scenes.caption: The hidden truth
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking at a holographic message left by his future self, realizing the true meaning of the warning.

scenes.text: Kavi reaches forward, abandoning all caution, and plunges a hand into the swirling, unstable vortex.
scenes.caption: Reaching for the end
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi reaching out his hand towards the center of the Red Door as the world around him shatters.

scenes.text: Pain screams through Kavi as fingers dissolve into the same purple glitch-matter that consumed Null.
scenes.caption: Corrupted by the loop
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi's hand turning into purple glitch-matter upon touching the surface of the Red Door, his expression one of terror.
